item.title: 2026 AAM Awards: All The Winners
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and trends. Today, we're coming to you live from Sydney, where the Association of Artist Managers just announced their fifth annual awards. Let's take a look at the big winners."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "Taking home the top prize for Manager of the Year were Sundowner Artists' Simone Ubaldi and Andrew Parisi. They manage the international punk rock sensation Amyl And The Sniffers, and this isn't their first win - they also took home the same category in 2022."
[Clip of Amy Taylor's statement plays]
Host: "As Amy Taylor, the lead singer of Amyl And The Sniffers, put it, Simone and Andrew are more than just managers. They're dedicated to their artists and passionate about the music community. And it's clear that their hard work has paid off."
[Soft music continues]
Host: "The AAM Awards recognize the managers behind the scenes, driving strategy and navigating complexity to make their artists' careers happen. This year's nominees reflected the strength, diversity, and ambition of the Australian music community."
[Clip of Maggie Collins' statement plays]
Host: "AAM Executive Director Maggie Collins noted that the winners set the benchmark for modern management - forward-thinking, resilient, and deeply invested in their artists' success."
[Soft music transitions out]
Host: "Other notable winners included Melita Hodge, who received the Legacy Award, and Kristie McCarthy, who took home the 2026 APRA AMCOS Lighthouse Award, along with a A$5,000 grant to support her business and professional pursuits."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Congratulations to all the winners, and thanks for tuning in. We'll be back with more music news and updates soon."
